content.title: We noticed you've been quiet lately
content.body: The past couple weeks have been rough, haven't they? Life got busy, routines slipped, and suddenly health goals felt like one more thing on an impossible list. This is completely normal. Most people hit this exact moment around week 3 or 4. It doesn't mean you've failed or that this isn't working. It just means you're human, navigating a busy life. We're still here.

content.title: Did you know? Iron needs are higher for women
content.body: You need 18mg of iron daily—nearly double what men need—to prevent anemia and fatigue. Yet 1 in 5 young Singaporean women are iron-deficient. Add iron-rich foods like spinach, lentils, or lean meat to your meals, and pair them with vitamin C for better absorption.

metadata.rationale: Prime iron awareness before future action. User has anemia (hemoglobin 10.8 g/dL Oct 25), last viewed iron content Nov 10 (18 days ago). CBT technique: behavioral_activation to normalize iron deficiency and build knowledge. Narrative position: build, education without pressure. DYK card quota: 1/2 max. Showcases Genie differentiator: medical data integration.

Sleep improvements show up in 3-5 days. Iron levels typically respond within 2-4 weeks. You're dealing with two highly treatable causes.
